name: Paired Agent Security Benchmark Suite
mechanism: Runs benign utility and adversarial tool-use cases against a complete agent environment and scores authoritative external state rather than model text alone.
use_when: Security controls must preserve legitimate task utility
avoid_when: Only a chatbot response with no tools data access or memory is evaluated
Benchmark tools and schemas do not resemble the deployed workload
expected_effects: Measured unauthorized effects alongside benign task success
Reproducible injection and exfiltration development baselines
failure_modes: Text graders disagree with actual tool state
